newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Ossolineum loading 55,000 tonnes soybeans. Hsing May loading 54,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Aghia Markella loading 51,698 tonnes soybeans/meal. Waiting to dock, seven vessels to load soymeal.
Road: 1,723 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between May 30 and June 1, 837 trucks with soymeal and 207 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Gina Iuliano loading 53,550 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, Panli to load 36,550 tonnes soybeans and Pythagoras of Samo to load 36,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Lika loading 60,000 tonnes soybeans. No vessels waiting to dock.
Road: 54 trucks carrying 1,440 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 1 as well as three trucks with 66 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 62 wagons arrived carrying 3,407 tonnes soybeans.
